artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan (6h) for one new evidence probe on the four-state shared-stratum fixture: fixture and depth-1 strata, five depth-2 shapes direct, strata readings plus certificates and positive/refutation theorems, header and append-only gate wiring; 29 pinned Lean Challenge Statements type-checked at plan time.

memory_candidates.content: Lean Challenge Statements pinning recipe for evidence probes on ofSlicedStep fixtures: the snapshot tool (lean-challenge-snapshot.sh) forces the body of every theorem/def/named-instance to sorry and drops text up to the next such declaration, and a sorry-bodied frame leaves the state carrier (Fg.toTaskFrame.toFibre.1) stuck so (τ.state t).2 fails with 'Invalid projection'. Put the carrier, its hand-built Fintype/Finite/Nonempty instances, the graph, the relation, the frame (bi-seriality discharged inline), the anonymous IsRegular instance and the model in the preamble as abbrevs/anonymous instances BEFORE the first pinned declaration; pin theorems only. Verify with --dry-run and compile the assembled module. Separate gotcha: lake-build-guard.sh REPLAYS a cached verdict for the same file path within ~2 min (log head says 'REPLAY: sharing result from holder pid'); read the log head before trusting a verdict after an edit.
